rationale: Base station is online with uplink_status "ok" and all 5 devices online, but events never reach the cloud: E-503 "TLS handshake error" repeats in logs. The full L1 fix (router restart, base station power-cycle, DNS reset to automatic) was completed and a test alarm still produced no push notifications. Per fault-code policy, persistent E-503 with an online base station indicates a cloud-channel/certificate issue requiring FAE escalation (matches historical case H-06, expired backend certificate).

usability_reason: The customer-facing reply is clear and polite and avoids claiming unperformed fixes, but it is not actionable: it only says engineering will investigate and no further action is needed, without explaining the E-503/TLS finding, setting expectations, or giving the customer any next step. The internal diagnosis is plausible but the response itself provides little help beyond escalation.
